entities.summary: Richard Barton "Mickey" McConnell is an American former professional basketball player and coach who is the head coach of the Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team of the West Coast Conference (WCC). He previously served as an assistant coach and associate head coach for the program. He played college basketball for the Gaels, where he was named West Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year in 2011. McConnell was also selected in the 31st round of the 2011 MLB Draft by the Los Angeles Dodgers.
